investigatedCandidates.provenance: Phase 8.1 incorrectly attributed EmojiNet to USC ISI / emojinet.org. Re-investigation on 2026-08-09: DNS lookup ENOTFOUND for emojinet.org and www.emojinet.org. No evidence this domain ever hosted the Wright State/Kno.e.sis EmojiNet sense inventory. Rejected as unrelated/misidentified.
GitHub repository https://github.com/usc-isi-i2/emojinet returns HTTP 404. USC ISI I2 organization has no EmojiNet repository. Not the Wijeratne et al. EmojiNet dataset. Rejected.

Internet Archive has HTML captures but no archived copy of emojidata.zip in CDX index. Identity established; direct download currently unavailable.

investigatedCandidates.provenance: Author Sanjaya Wijeratne links this Kaggle page from https://sanjw.github.io/ as the open-sourced EmojiNet dataset (uploaded by Rachael Tatman, November 2017). Kaggle API metadata credits Wijeratne et al., cites ICWSM 2017, references emojinet.knoesis.org, and reports 12,904 sense labels over 2,389 emoji. Bundle downloaded 2026-08-09 without authentication via Kaggle signed redirect; contains emojis.json only. Verified counts in file: 2389 emoji records, 2389 unicode mappings, 15183 BabelNet sense groups, 80113 sense-definition strings. Published sense-label total (12,904) retained as canonical dataset statistic from ICWSM 2017.

resolution.provenance: Phase 8.1 incorrectly locked emojinet.org and usc-isi-i2/emojinet — neither is the Wright State EmojiNet project. The original project is hosted at http://emojinet.knoesis.org/ (currently offline). The author-endorsed reproducible public mirror is Kaggle rtatman/emojinet version 1 (2017-11-02), linked from the author's homepage. Identity verified via author attribution, ICWSM 2017 metadata match (2,389 emoji / 12,904 sense labels), and post-download structural verification of emojis.json (SHA-256 5342d56cd4700876ff661c921adc52e6276d8d667a4cadbaa2a05379a468e633). Original bulk URL http://emojinet.knoesis.org/dataset/emojidata.zip is documented on archived dataset.php but is not currently downloadable and has no Internet Archive binary capture.
